meta.title: Awesome Game Modding AI
meta.tagline: Curated, link-verified AI tooling for modding, asset generation and reverse engineering.
meta.intro: AI has moved into game modding from both ends: LLM agents that read a game's internals and rebuild its assets, and generative pipelines that produce the textures, models and voices a mod needs. This list indexes the tooling that is actually usable today — mod frameworks, asset generation, generative NPCs and audio, community decompilation projects, and localization tools. Every link is checked to be live when this README is regenerated.
meta.disclaimer: Compiled from public sources — no independent testing of the linked projects.

sections.title: AI Modding Frameworks
sections.description: Frameworks, CLIs and MCP servers that give an AI agent the tools to inspect, decompile and rebuild a game's mods.

items.name: universal-modder
items.what: Skills, tools and MCP that let Claude Code mod almost any PC game: recon, reverse engineering, art, 3D and audio.

items.name: game-changer
items.what: The AI game-modding toolkit from Fixed Seed: agent skills, the fsgc CLI, an MCP server and a knowledge base.

items.name: modmixer
items.what: Desktop app that decompiles and indexes your game, then gives a coding LLM the tools to build and test mods.

items.name: Passthrough-Mod-Forge
items.what: AI-powered forge for passthrough mods and dual-game runtimes, including AI asset generation.

items.name: re-engine-mcp
items.what: MCP server that gives AI agents live access to any running RE Engine game through REFramework.

sections.title: Asset Generation
sections.description: Textures, 3D models and sprites produced with diffusion and 3D generation pipelines.

items.name: 3DCellForge
items.what: AI-powered interactive 3D model generation, inspection and presentation studio.

items.name: ComfyUI-BlenderAI-node
items.what: ComfyUI nodes inside Blender for AI model generation plus texture enhancement and generation.

items.name: UltraGameStudio
items.what: AI coding agent for game development covering engine workflows, gameplay code and asset generation.

items.name: ai-game-studio
items.what: AI generation of 2D game assets such as spritesheets.

items.name: FrameForge
items.what: AI-powered asset generation tool for game developers, producing visual and audio assets.

items.name: SeqTex
items.what: End-to-end 3D texture generation using video diffusion priors, published at SIGGRAPH Asia 2025.

items.name: OpenAITexGenSlateTool
items.what: An OpenAI image-model based texture generation plugin for Unreal Engine 5.

sections.title: NPCs, Voice and Audio
sections.description: LLM-driven characters, cloned voices and generative audio that run inside a real game.

items.name: LLMUnity
items.what: Create characters in Unity driven by large language models.

items.name: Interactive-LLM-Powered-NPCs
items.what: Project that transforms interaction with NPCs in any game using interactive LLMs.

items.name: UnrealGenAISupport
items.what: Unreal Engine plugin for LLM and GenAI models plus an MCP server, covering NPC AI, TTS and 3D generation.

items.name: jubensha-ai
items.what: AI-powered murder mystery where every character is an AI, with script, TTS voice and image generation.

items.name: mc_aiplayer
items.what: Server-side Fabric mod where an LLM drives a real Minecraft player to mine, build, farm and fight.

items.name: chasm
items.what: Local-first, game-agnostic AI backend for agentic NPCs, providing LLM, cloned voices and memory.

sections.title: Decompilation and Reverse Engineering
sections.description: Community reverse-engineering and decompilation projects — the ground truth that modding is built on.

items.name: REDRIVER2
items.what: Driver 2 PlayStation game reverse engineering effort, now a playable source port.

items.name: sotn-decomp
items.what: Decompilation of Castlevania: Symphony of the Night for PSX, PSP and Saturn.

items.name: fallout2-re
items.what: Reverse engineered Fallout 2, from the original binaries back to readable source.

items.name: LibertyFlux
items.what: Grand Theft Auto IV's engine being rewritten in Rust one function at a time by AI agents.

sections.title: Localization and Translation
sections.description: Tools that extract a game's or a mod's text and translate it, often using local models.

items.name: GameStringer
items.what: Desktop app that auto-detects a game's engine, extracts the text and translates it with local AI models.

items.name: Remis
items.what: AI-powered desktop localization for game mods, including Paradox games and Surviving Mars: Relaunched.

items.name: UnityGameTranslator
items.what: Universal Unity game translation using local AI models, with community sharing of improvements.

items.name: NIM-Translator
items.what: Free open-source tool for Skyrim mod localization, supporting PEX, ESM and ESP files.
